arStrings.szText: Primary Skill: Damage and inflict bleeding on your enemy.

{c_important}Flay{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} chance to make the enemy {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} seconds. Double this chance when using a Two-Handed weapon.
{c_important}Flay's{/c} Bleeding duration is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_27}||]{/c} seconds and it makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Flay's{/c} Bleeding is extended by {c_number}[{SF_12}]{/c} |4second:seconds; whenever the enemy moves too far from you.

If {c_important}Flay{/c} hits a Bleeding enemy it causes a blood explosion that inflicts {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_BLEEDING}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEC_BLEEDING}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Flay's{/c} Bleeding duration is increased by {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} seconds.

Each Nearby enemy Bleeding from {c_important}Flay{/c} Heals you for {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life ({c_number}{heal:UPGRADE4_HEAL_TOOLTIP}{/c}) per second, up to {c_number}[{SF_35}*{SF_34}*100|%|]{/c}.
